He declared for the [[2026 NBA draft]] in April 2026 and was selected 56th overall by the [[Chicago Bulls]], who then immediately traded his draft rights to the [[Dallas Mavericks]].{{Cite web |title=NBA 2026 Draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/draft/rounds/_/round/2 |url-status=live |access-date=2026-06-25 |website=www.espn.com}}{{Cite web |title=Player Profile - Vsevolod Ishchenko |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/_/id/5358755/vsevolod-ishchenko |access-date=2026-06-25 |website=www.espn.com}} == Early life and youth career == Ishchenko was born on February 10, 2005 in [[Rostov-on-Don]], Russia.{{Cite web |title=Player Biography - Vsevolod Ishchenko|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/player/bio/_/id/5358755/vsevolod-ishchenko|access-date=2026-06-25 |website=www.espn.com}} He developed through multiple youth basketball programs in Rostov-on-Don before joining the Lokomotiv Kuban development system.{{cite web|title=Vsevolod Ishchenko profile|url=https://lokobasket.com/en/player/loko/vsevolod-ishhenko-5/|website=Lokomotiv Kuban|access-date=June 25, 2026}} He was MVP of the VTB United Youth League Supercup (2023), first-team All-VTB United Youth League in 2023–24 and averaged 16.1 points, 7.0 rebounds and 4.3 assists for Lokomotiv Kuban-2.{{cite web|title=Lokomotiv Kuban youth awards|url=https://lokobasket.com/en/player/loko/vsevolod-ishhenko-5/|website=Lokomotiv Kuban|access-date=June 25, 2026}} == Professional career == === Lokomotiv Kuban (2024–present) === Ishchenko joined the senior roster of [[Lokomotiv Kuban]] in September 2024, competing in the [[VTB United League]].{{cite web|title=Lokomotiv Kuban roster news|url=https://vtb-league.com/en/news/lokomotiv-kuban-is-ready-for-the-2024-25-season/|website=VTB United League|access-date=June 25, 2026}} During the 2025–26 season, Ishchenko averaged 8.7 points, 4.5 rebounds, 2.1 assists, and 1.3 steals per game.{{cite web|title=Vsevolod Ischenko named the Young Player of the Year|url=https://vtb-league.com/en/news/vsevolod-ischenko-named-the-young-player-of-the-year/|website=VTB United League|access-date=June 25, 2026}} He also played with Lokomotiv Kuban in the [[Winline Basket Cup]], but they were eliminated after the group stage. He was named a VTB United League All-Star,{{cite web |title=Mavs add rookies Tobi Lawal, Vsevolod Ishchenko, and Sergio De Larrea to their roster |url=https://www.nba.com/mavs/news/mavs-add-forward-tobi-lawal-and-guard-sergio-de-larrea-to-their-roster |website=[[NBA.com]] |publisher=NBA.com |date=June 25, 2026 |access-date=June 26, 2026 }} and was named as the [[VTB United League Young Player of the Year]] (2025–26) and recorded multiple standout performances, including his first career [[double-double]] and a game with 15 points and a season high 6 steals.{{cite web|title=Career first double-double for Ishchenko|url=https://vtb-league.com/en/news/vsevolod-ishchenko-recorded-career-first-double-double/|website=VTB United League|access-date=June 25, 2026}}{{cite web |title=Vsevolod Ishchenko scored 15 points and 6 steals versus Astana |url=https://vtb-league.com/en/news/vsevolod-ishchenko-scored-15-points-and-6-steals-versus-astana/ |website=[[VTB United League]] |date=November 11, 2024 |access-date=June 26, 2026 }} On February 8, 2026, Ishchenko scored a career high 20 points, paired with 4 assists. 3 rebounds, steals, and a block against [[BC UNICS]].{{cite web |title=Vsevolod Ischenko and Alexey Shved duel in Krasnodar |url=https://vtb-league.com/en/news/vsevolod-ischenko-and-alexey-shved-duel-in-krasnodar/ |website=[[VTB United League]] |date=February 8, 2026 |access-date=July 26, 2026}} Following his conclusion to the 2026 NBA Summer League, it was announced on August 3, 2026 that Ishchenko would be returning to [[PBC Lokomotiv Kuban]] for the 2026–27 basketball season.{{cite web |title=Mavs' Vsevolod Ishchenko Returning Overseas Instead of NBA Signing|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/mavs-vsevolod-ishchenko-returning-overseas-170033770.html |website=[[Yahoo Sports]]|access-date=August 7, 2026}}{{cite web |last=McGee |first=Austin |title=Vsevolod Ishchenko update is bittersweet for Mavericks fans |url=https://thesmokingcuban.com/vsevolod-ishchenko-update-is-bittersweet-for-mavericks-fans |website=The Smoking Cuban |date=August 5, 2026 |access-date=August 7, 2026}}{{cite web |last=Weber |first=Noah |title=Mavericks' Vsevolod Ishchenko decision is better than it looks |url=https://thesmokingcuban.com/mavericks-vsevolod-ishchenko-decision-is-better-than-it-looks |website=The Smoking Cuban |date=August 9, 2026 |access-date=August 9, 2026}} === NBA draft rights === In April 2026, Ishchenko declared for the [[2026 NBA draft]].{{cite web|title=NBA Draft Profile – Vsevolod Ishchenko|url=https://www.nba.com/draft/2026/prospects/vsevolod-ishchenko|website=[[NBA.com]]|access-date=June 25, 2026}}{{cite web |last=Sweet |first=Randall |title=5 International Prospects Declare for 2026 NBA Draft |url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/5-international-prospects-declare-for-2026-nba-draft-01kq2ktcnfw2 |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=April 25, 2026 |access-date=August 9, 2026}} On June 25, 2026, Ishchenko was selected with the 56th overall pick by the [[Chicago Bulls]] in the [[2026 NBA draft]]. His draft rights were subsequently traded to the [[Dallas Mavericks]] via the [[Los Angeles Lakers]] on draft night.{{cite news |title=Mavericks Acquire Draft Rights to 56th Overall Pick Vsevolod Ishchenko|url=https://www.nba.com/mavs/news/mavericks-acquire-draft-rights-to-56th-overall-pick-vsevolod-ishchenko|work=[[nba.com]]|date=June 24, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}}{{cite news |title=2026 NBA Draft: Mavericks draft Russian guard Vsevolod Ishchenko|url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/2026-nba-draft-mavericks-draft-023051445.html |work=[[Yahoo Sports]] |date=June 24, 2026 |access-date=June 24, 2026}} On July 3, 2026, it was announced that Ishchenko will be participating with the Mavericks during the [[2026 NBA Summer League]].{{cite web |last=Curtis |first=Mike |url=https://www.dallasnews.com/sports/mavericks/article/summer-league-roster-morez-johnson-nembhard-sergio-22331856.php |title=Mavericks reveal Summer League roster featuring Morez Johnson, Ryan Nembhard Jr., Sergio de Larrea |website=[[The Dallas Morning News]] |date=July 3, 2026 |access-date=July 3, 2026}} Ishchenko appeared in all five Summer League games for the Mavericks, and finished with 9.6 points, 4.4 rebounds, and 3 assists in an average of 27.5 minutes.{{cite web|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/nba/teams/Dallas-Mavericks/6/Rosters/Summer_League|title=2026 Dallas 2026 NBA Summer League Stats|website=[[RealGM]] |date=July 17, 2026 |access-date=July 18, 2026}}{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/mavericks/onsi/grading-each-dallas-mavericks-draft-pick-nba-summer-league-performance-morez-johnson-jr-|title=Grading Each Mavericks Draft Pick's NBA Summer League Performance|website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=July 19, 2026 |access-date=July 19, 2026}} ==National team career== Ishchenko made his debut for the [[Russia national basketball team]] in 2025, appearing in two friendly international games.{{cite web|title=Russia vs Iran friendly game report|url=https://russiabasket.ru/post/43692|website=Russia Basketball Federation|access-date=June 25, 2026}}{{cite web|title=Russia vs Egypt friendly game report|url=https://russiabasket.ru/post/43706|website=Russia Basketball Federation|access-date=June 25, 2026}} ==Player profile== Ishchenko is measured at 6 feet 8 inches (2.03 m){{cite news |last=D. Smith |first=Marcus |title=Who did Lakers pick Wednesday? LA makes another move after Bulls NBA Draft trade|url=https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/2026/06/24/nba-draft-lakers-bulls-trade-second-round/90678658007/ |work=[[USA Today]] |date=June 24, 2026 |access-date=July 26, 2026}} and 218 pounds,{{cite web |last=Afseth |first=Grant |title=Dallas Mavericks Land Draft Rights To Russian Guard Vsevolod Ishchenko In Deal With Los Angeles Lakers |url=https://dallashoopsjournal.com/mavericks-vsevolod-ishchenko-draft-rights-lakers/ |website=Dallas Hoops Journal |date=June 25, 2026 |access-date=July 27, 2026}} with a seven foot wingspan. Ishchenko is known for his [[shot-blocking]] defense, using his size to get blocks against other players.{{cite news |last=Afseth |first=Grant |title=Vsevolod Ishchenko's Defense Against Cameron Boozer Shows Strong Value |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/vsevolod-ishchenkos-defense-against-cameron-033118641.html |work=[[Yahoo Sports]] |date=July 16, 2026 |access-date=July 27, 2026}} Outside of his defense, he's known for high motor and physicality which he uses to take contact and grab offensive and defensive rebounds.{{cite web |last=Weber|first=Noah |title=Mavericks-Lakers draft night trade already looks like steal for Dallas |url=https://thesmokingcuban.com/mavericks-lakers-draft-night-trade-already-looks-like-steal-for-dallas |website=The Smoking Cuban |date=July 17, 2026 |access-date=July 27, 2026}} Despite possessing defensive prowess, Ishchenko is not known to be a dominant scorer,{{cite web |last=Veazey |first=Austin |title=2 Factors Could Keep Mavericks From Signing Second-Round Pick|url=https://www.si.com/nba/mavericks/onsi/2-factors-could-keep-dallas-mavericks-from-signing-second-round-pick-vsevolod-ishchenko- |website=[[Sports Illustrated]] |date=July 25, 2026 |access-date=July 27, 2026}} however, he excels at the [[three-point shot]].{{cite web |last=Wyrich |first=Andrew |title=Instant 2026 NBA Draft Grade: Mavericks Trade With Lakers for International Shooter|url=https://www.si.com/nba/mavericks/onsi/instant-2026-nba-draft-grade-dallas-mavericks-trade-los-angeles-lakers-international-shooter-vsevolod-ishchenko- |website=[[Sports
